description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'DistributedData' that provides an interface and partial implementation for managing distributed data within an Akka cluster environment. The class manages replication, configuration, and data access/modification methods, with concrete subclasses expected to define specific keys and initial values. It leverages Akka actors and cluster data primitives, and includes support for asynchronous operations, configuration creation, and change subscriptions.

classes.name: DistributedData
classes.description: Abstract class managing distributed replicated data in Akka, including creation of replicator actors, data access, modification, and subscriptions. It supports configuration and asynchronous operations, serving as a base for specific distributed data types.

classes.name: DistributedData.AbstractDDataProvider
classes.description: Abstract extension id provider class for creating and loading distributed data extensions associated with specific replicated data types.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Abstract method that returns the unique key for the distributed data collection.

methods.name: getInitialValue
methods.description: Abstract method to provide the initial value of the distributed data object.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current replicated data with specified read consistency.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Modifies the replicated data asynchronously using a provided update function and specified write consistency.

methods.name: subscribeForChanges
methods.description: Subscribes an actor to receive notifications when the distributed data changes.

methods.name: getReplicator
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef of the underlying replicator actor.
